nodes.source: docs/data-pack-startup.md (Skipped statements); docs/setting-value-offset.md (Tabled calls; What the settings were; Remainder); VEGAS-52 comment of 2026-11-13
nodes.detail: S6 writes the processor count into the setting g_011c3ea4 through FUN_0043d4d0. The repository names two prerequisites: the owner of that setting, which a generated dynamic initializer builds (D2), and the closure of magicitem.cpp. A VEGAS-52 comment of 2026-11-13, measured at 11d59dc97, names four. A generated unit defines the setting, and that unit's startup initializer builds it and reads original data (D2). Building it natively needs the constructor of INISettingCollection and Setting::IsPrefSetting, and no object defines either. DAT_01202800 is generated data too. The coordinator ruled that S6 and S8 stay skipped until these four are met and that VEGAS-111 repairs the accessor first. Since c3ad69b43 the accessor takes the shared Setting and returns its value at plus 8 (VEGAS-111). main.cpp's 41 calls of it, WinMain's three writes of the processor count among them, stay on the old form int& FUN_0043d4d0(int*), which no object defines; VEGAS-115 moves them. In WinMain's order, S6 and S8 come before the second-window check.

nodes.label: Shared NiObject with its virtual slot table
nodes.source: docs/shared-gamebryo-bases.md (NiObject; Integration checks; Not covered); include/fnv/ni_object.h, since 0b408d396; docs/boot-real-classes.md (What would let them move); VEGAS-30 ruling (3) of 2026-11-13: bases go base first; VEGAS-11 rulings of 2026-11-13
nodes.detail: Since 0b408d396 include/fnv/ni_object.h declares NiObject on the shared NiRefObject, with no fields of its own, its constructor, its virtual destructor and the 33 virtual functions of slots 2 to 34. Every one of the 33 is open: no function row under the class's name fills a slot, so the names are the spelling of the two units on the header and nothing may be concluded from them. Two units use it. The other copies stay, among them the 62 units on include/NiObject.h, which declares two slots, because their slots or size differ, or, for nicamera.cpp, its NiRefObject is not the shared one. NiObject::NiObject, its destructor and GetType are still undefined. The first unit on the header that emits the class's table binds that table and is not a declaration move. The step changed no object and took no name from the link.

coverage: The map covers the accepted steps of main in src/main.cpp, in order, and the setup steps that make the pack.
It covers the eight statements of WinMain that main skips, as docs/data-pack-startup.md tables them.
It covers the four boot bodies that WinMain reaches by name, and the contracts that docs/winmain-boot-names.md and docs/boot-real-classes.md record for them, by class and not name by name.
Tickets appear only where a node names them; ticket states are the tracker's on the date above.
limitations: The map is not a call graph. It shows four calls of WinMain and no others; the boot closure has about 21,000 names.

Forced-link counts measure the whole archive. They say nothing about what a running game reaches. VEGAS-30's first criterion is about FalloutNV.exe's own link. Nobody measured which of these names a boot to the main menu reaches.
Estimates are single-name model counts. They are not additive and no link measured them.

The state of a node with a tracker state comes from the tracker's state on the ticket-state date, and curated edges come from tickets, tracker comments and rulings. No machine check confirms them, and they can be stale the day after the snapshot.
The map leaves out VEGAS-100 and VEGAS-105, because neither src/main.cpp nor src/fallout/misc/main.cpp names g_010173f0. Nobody measured their relation to the boot closure.

The map leaves out VEGAS-103, in progress with its criterion 2 tabled to VEGAS-113, and VEGAS-106, done, because no source of a node names them. The repairs of VEGAS-103, integrated at b7007f0f7, took two names from the forced link.

The edges from VEGAS-112 to S3 and S7 and from VEGAS-110 to the shared bases are curated relationships recorded on those tickets on 2026-11-13. The table of skipped statements does not list VEGAS-112 for S7, and no check measures either. The edges from VEGAS-115 to S6 and S8 come from docs/setting-value-offset.md, and the edge from VEGAS-111 to VEGAS-115 from a VEGAS-111 comment of 2026-11-13; no check measures them either.

The map leaves out VEGAS-117, which the VEGAS-111 comment of 2026-11-13 names with VEGAS-115 as what keeps VEGAS-111 open, and VEGAS-116 and VEGAS-118, which it calls related. No source names any of the three as a prerequisite of a startup statement or a boot body, and nobody measured their relation to the boot closure. The VEGAS-111 node names them.
No source states that the next stage waits on S1 to S8; the map draws no such edge.

In Windows CI run 43421396743 at the snapshot commit the test docs.startup_map.generator fails: two of its tests run --check on a file on another drive than the repository, and the generator cannot name that file relative to the repository. docs.startup_map passes.
